courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：堆疊拓撲、累積誤差與可測性。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Stack topology, accumulated error and testability. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合
related.why: 共用良品篩選、表面與對位證據
related.whyEn: Shares die screening, surface and overlay evidence
related.transfer: 共用良品篩選、表面與對位證據
related.transferEn: Shares die screening, surface and overlay evidence
related.difference: 晶粒對晶粒處理對象更小且兩側支撐不同
related.differenceEn: D2D uses smaller workpieces with different support on both sides
practice: 以「面向與拓撲」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「面對面與背對面堆疊改變 TSV 需求和可用電極。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫每層訊號、電源和背面。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use orientation and topology to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Face-to-face versus back-to-face changes TSV needs and accessible pads.
Using "Draw signals, supplies and backsides for every layer.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 3D 邏輯堆疊熱管理
related.why: 堆疊熱阻和熱源位置直接耦合
related.whyEn: Stack thermal resistance couples directly to heat-source position
related.transfer: 堆疊熱阻和熱源位置直接耦合
related.transferEn: Stack thermal resistance couples directly to heat-source position
related.difference: 本課組裝可行性不取代熱管理的系統邊界
related.differenceEn: Assembly feasibility does not replace system thermal boundaries
practice: 以「逐層對位」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「相對每層對準不保證對共同基準的累積誤差小。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「同時繪相鄰誤差與全堆疊基準誤差。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use layer-by-layer overlay to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Good adjacent-layer overlay need not ensure small error to a common datum.
Using "Plot adjacent-layer and common-datum errors.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
